MLFB configurator · pressure

SITRANS P320

Configure the transmitter, build the Siemens code and add it to the cart. Each code position corresponds to a zone of the transmitter: hover over it and it lights up red on the drawing.

How it works. The configurator builds the MLFB code from your choices. If the configuration is already on the Nortek Hendriks price list, the price appears immediately; otherwise it is added "on quotation" and Nortek Hendriks verifies the code on the Siemens PIA portal and answers with confirmed code, price and delivery time within 24–48 hours.

How to read the configurator

Options tagged PIA were read from the Siemens configurator: description and value are the official ones. Options tagged catalogue exist in the Siemens FI 01 catalogue but have not been verified yet: only the letter is shown, and Nortek Hendriks verifies it before the offer.

The -Z suffix is part of the code. Without cable glands and approval declared, the Siemens portal treats the configuration as incomplete.

The drawing is a front view, to scale, with the main dimensions from the Siemens FI 01 catalogue (08/2026 edition). It shows where each code position acts; for installation the Siemens dimensional drawings apply. Other families (P420, FMS500, LT500, TH320…) are available in the catalogue with their price and will get their own configurator.
